name: 06450 · Meriden, CT
findings: ZIP 06450 (Meriden) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06450 (Meriden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06450 (Meriden) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
